text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.23 for the AI Software Developer position. The strongest evidence for their candidacy is a computer science degree and 4.54 years of relevant experience, alongside listed skills in "JavaScript", "React", and "Docker". Key gaps include the absence of required machine learning, C#, and SQL expertise, as well as missing nice-to-have skills like .NET, TypeScript, and NoSQL. Despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements, this application has been escalated for further review.
